notes.title: Just moved the game to a new framework to make it easier to update
notes.notes:
But if you encounter bugs in the game, keep in mind that it may be due to the new framework.
Let me know so I can fix it.

notes.title: Casual patch
notes.notes:
You can now enable “Casual Mode” in the game settings.

Details of this mode:
[list]
[*]When start any fragment the aerocycle strength will be 100%.
[*]Aerocycle strength at the completed stages will be equal to 1%.
[*]Damage increased by 4 times.
[*] “Solid race” is not available.
[/list]

Of course the developer recommends playing the game in standard mode. But he doesn’t insist.

notes.title: 120 / 240 FPS; Appearance; Steam Deck; Minor changes
notes.notes:
[b]Supports 120 and 240 FPS[/b]
Previously, the game only ran at either 60 or 30 FPS. The list has been expanded. Depending on the load on the processors and the computer configuration, the frame rate will automatically switch between 10/15/20/24/30/40/48/60/80/120/240 FPS with the ability to set the maximum value.

[b]Surroundings of the track[/b]
I added simple models in some places so that the gloomy black mass around became a little less gloomy and black.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43266757/812cb3f11383996f1c6a0acb5dccd498a11a3684.gif[/img]

[b]New text display system[/b]
In-game text may begin to appear slightly differently than before. And also to the fact that files containing text are now encrypted.

[b]Minor text edits[/b]
I re-read the dialogue and descriptions and changed some things to just make it sound better, more enjoyable, and more accessible. Unfortunately, only in Russian, since I am not as fluent in other languages.

[b]Enter / Space in the menu[/b]
The update for which everything was started. Now you can make selections in the menu not only with the Enter button, but also with the Space button.

[b]User interface in training mode[/b]
Minor changes/bug fixes.

[b]Images in «Details»[/b]
To hide the appearance of the inaccessible buttons, I previously used blur. Over time I found the result to be unpleasant looking, so now mosaic is used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43266757/33621d899e6c6b64efec6344daa6ec1c46e92187.png[/img]

[b]Control tips[/b]
Smoothly appear on the screen. They change if several keys are responsible for one action. They are also aligned relative to each other.

[b]Optimization in the office[/b]
Updating the right monitor used to take a lot of processor resources. Now there is no.

[b]Dash correction[/b]
Although who cares about it anymore.

[b]Edits in animations[/b]
Unique situations may arise that cause some animations to not execute correctly. Fixed.

[b]Adaptation for Steam Deck[/b]
When using the Steam Deck, the monitors with text during briefings are positioned closer to the character than usual, so that the text on the device screen is a more pleasant size.
+ all sorts of little things
And also a beautiful picture is displayed as the device used instead of a gamepad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43266757/61808903779358addc254b42244887a5e899b95d.png[/img]

notes.title: Small update. 24.03.2023
notes.notes:
- Decreased the thresholds for getting the 12th stage achievement
- Changed buttons to change the speed of map movement in offices

notes.title: Interface changes
notes.notes:
On some video cards, the interface was full of artifacts. Now it's all good.

Players using 2K resolutions or more had the UI cut off on the right side of the screen after visiting the office. No more should.
